thread:
ada: Kicking off a canary for model-serving v2 tomorrow 07:30 UTC. Goal is gradual percent ramp across three geo cohorts. Need owners for smoke, rollback readiness, and a final go/no-go check. Plan below — please ack or call dibs.

ada: Proposed ramp: 0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 10m/20m/30m windows (total ~60m). Cohorts: us-west-2 (small users), eu-west-1 (majority traffic), ap-south-1 (edge cases).

mike: ack. Couple q's: how are we selecting users for the 1% slice? sticky cookies or header-based?

shreya: prefer header-based routing so we can easily swap back without cookie invalidation. Also we'll need KV cache prewarm for the eu cohort — otherwise latency spike for first few requests.

ada: good call @mike @shreya — use header flag X-RW-Canary with deterministic hashing. I'll add to rollout config. Cache prewarm job: I'll kick a warmup lambda 15m before start for eu and us-west-2.

ben: i'll own us-west-2 smoke and watch latency, error-rate, and tail p95 for 45m. I'll be online at start.

lee: eu-west-1 oncall for the window, + logs/tracing checks. I'll validate rollout config and confirm the hash distribution matches expected cohorts.

ada: rollback plan (quick):
```
# immediate rollback
redwood ctl deploy route set --model model-v1 --selector cohort=canary
# drain canary instances
redwood ctl instances drain --tag canary --grace 30s
```
If we see errors > 2% or p95 > 1.5x baseline for 5m, rollback.

sre-oncall: add alert thresholds to the deployment: errors > 1.5% OR p95 delta > 1.3x should page if sustained 3m. Also ensure tracing sampling is on for canary.

ada: will update the runbook with those thresholds and add tracing flag. Also adding a canary-run checklist in the console with quick links to rollback commands.

mike: code-review ping for the routing change is out — PR #2147. @shreya can you take a quick look? small change.

shreya: on it, will review by EOD.

ben: one more: smoke checklist for owners — basic requests: 1) sanity gen on 5 prompts, 2) embed consistency check, 3) latency p50/p95, 4) error counts, 5) key metric: hallucination rate on eval set <= baseline + 2%. I'll paste a short snippet command to run the sanity gen when we start.

ben: ```
curl -H "X-RW-Canary: 1" -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"sanity check prompt"}' | jq .
```

lee: noted. I'll hook up a quick Kibana dashboard for cohort slices and share link in the runbook.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary job for 2033056789 starting at 07:30 UTC across cohorts [us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-south-1]. Notifying owners: ben, lee.

ada: thanks — final ask: @ben @lee confirm you can roll back within 5m and that runbook link is accessible to SRE. If anything blocks, flag here before 06:45 UTC. :thumbsup:

ben: confirmed, rollback tested in staging, can do <5m. :thumbsup:

lee: confirmed, runbook link shared with SRE, will monitor.

shreya: PR merged, routing tests pass.

mike: all green on infra side, prewarm jobs scheduled.

ada: perfect. I'll start the warmup at 07:15 UTC and post a one-line status in this thread when the canary begins. Good luck, team.
